name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 13 – Am 31
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13a. Calls for an increase of EUR 500 000 000 in commitment appropriations and EUR 400 000 000 in payment appropriations under the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) to uphold economic, social and territorial cohesion as a core pillar of European integration; stresses that these resources are urgently needed to support regions facing structural delays, industrial transitions, and severe job losses; warns that failing to secure this funding directly undermines regional resilience and deepens territorial disparities across the Union;
